open_decision_for_operator.phase5_behaviour: CALLER_DAILY_CAP does NOT spill (registry spill_on does not list it). Rationale: a per-caller cap is an anti-runaway breaker; a spill would move a loop bug onto SearXNG. If the operator decides a capped caller should still get an answer from the free lane, add "CALLER_DAILY_CAP" to web_search.spill_on — no code change needed, brave_router reads spill_on from the registry.
